migration_registry.purpose: Manages migration ordering and dependencies with topological sort

schema_checksum.purpose: Computes and verifies schema checksums to detect drift

migration_lock.purpose: Prevents concurrent migrations with distributed locking

backup_manager.purpose: Creates and manages database backups before migrations

migration_runner.purpose: Orchestrates migration execution with safety features
